title: A month of power deals, leaks and military AI
body: Over these thirty days the Endgame Index drifted darker. Horizon Balance, the single bright-versus-dark mood reading, started at +3.55 and ended at +1.93. The clearest risers were the dark and successor endings. Conquerors rose from 14.94 to 17.44 (+2.5) and Self-Destruction from 18.02 to 20.50 (+2.5). Descendants (+2.3), Zookeeper (+2.1), Protector God (+1.7) and Enslaved God (+1.4) also climbed. The losers were Egalitarian Utopia (-1.9, from 17.93 to 16.06), 1984 (-0.9), Libertarian Utopia (-0.9) and Reversion (-0.9). Enslaved God stayed the top ending throughout, at 36.40. Three threads drove the story. First, capability kept accelerating: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, DeepSeek's open V4 models and a Science study showing AI beating ER doctors pushed Capability Velocity from 68.0 to 70.85. Second, AI moved deeper into the military. Google's classified Pentagon deal and the Pentagon's agreements with seven AI firms lifted Catastrophic Risk from 55.05 to 56.64. Third, cooperation frayed. China blocked Meta's Manus deal and the EU delayed its AI Act, dropping Global Coordination from 25.0 to 23.62. Safety had mixed news. Unauthorized users reached Anthropic's withheld Mythos model and a UK study found steered sabotage, but more labs agreed to US government pre-release testing. Alignment & Control ended almost flat, from 42.1 to 41.98. Meanwhile a run of AI-linked layoffs at Snap, Meta, Coinbase, PayPal, Cloudflare and GM pulled Shared Prosperity down from 34.86 to 33.17. The final week was mostly quiet.
